vb_textbox.text: Red gnome = Brown gnome. Purple Gnome = Grey gnome. Red gnome + Brown gnome is opposite Purple + Grey Gnome. If you notice the mushroom becomes lower for, for example, red gnome, switch to the grey gnome if given gnome between red and grey. Or if your given the same example but the gnomes are purple and brown, switch to the purple gnome. If there is a case that your using the same combo of gnome but notice that the mushrooms are smaller in number, switch immediately. Good luck!
